description: Main application component for a React frontend that manages routing, authentication, layout, theme toggling, and navigation for a career navigator project.

classes.name: SessionState
classes.description: Interface representing the user session state, with userId and email.

classes.name: AppAuthState
classes.description: Interface extending SessionState with an isAdmin flag indicating admin privileges.

classes.name: GuardedRouteProps
classes.description: Props for the AuthGuard component, including the route element and access requirements.

methods.name: setAppAuthState
methods.description: Updates the global app auth state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: useIsAdmin
methods.description: Custom hook to derive isAdmin status from the singleton app auth state.

methods.name: AuthGuard
methods.description: Component that guards routes based on authentication and authorization, showing loading states and redirects as needed.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main application component that manages layout, navigation, user session, themes, and routing, including admin and user authentication handling.
